description: BaZi (Four Pillars) chart from birth data: pillars, hidden stems, ten gods, MingGe archetype (one of 55) and title, substance / volatility / rarity scores, structure verdict, favourable and unfavourable elements, shensha, the current luck decade with its score and reasons, and this year. Deterministic engine; nothing is stored. Price: $0.05 per chart.

birth.description: Birth data in local clock time (year, month, day, hour, minute; longitude + tz for true solar time). Build it with birth_form.

dstOff.description: True if the record ignores DST

chart_id.description: Saved chart id from my_charts, instead of birth (needs a MingGe account)

gender.description: Needed for luck decades (direction depends on gender); taken from the saved chart with chart_id

options.description: School / rule options as { group: id }; defaults match mingge.org. See list_options for groups and ids.

name: bazi_chart
